metadata.title: Take Action - Erase Horseracing India
metadata.description: Join the movement. Sign the pledge or volunteer with us to end horse racing in India.

hero.title: Take Action
hero.subtitle: Your voice matters. Choose how you want to support the movement to end horse racing in India.

pledge.title: Take the Pledge
intro: I pledge to stand against the exploitation of horses in racing. I recognize that horse racing is built on the suffering of animals who cannot consent to participate.
commitments: Never attend or financially support horse racing events
Advocate for policy changes to ban racing in my community
Raise awareness about the realities of horse racing
Support organizations working to end racing and protect horses
pledge.closing: Every horse deserves freedom, not a racetrack. By taking this pledge, I join thousands of others demanding change for horses across India.

fields.name: Name
fields.agree: I solemnly pledge to boycott horseracing and support efforts to end this industry in India

volunteer.title: Volunteer With Us
volunteer.subtitle: Help us plan the next steps in this movement. We need skilled, passionate people to research, advocate, document, and build a future without horse racing. Share your talents and availability below.
